description: This file defines an ASP.NET Web API exception filter class 'ApiExceptionFilter' that intercepts unhandled exceptions, logs them, and returns a structured JSON error response, optionally including stack trace details in debug mode.

classes.name: ApiExceptionFilter
classes.description: An exception filter for ASP.NET Web API that catches exceptions during API execution, logs error details, and constructs JSON responses with error information.

methods.name: ApiExceptionFilter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the filter with a logging strategy factory.

methods.name: ExecuteExceptionFilterAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously handles exceptions, logs them, and returns JSON-formatted error response.

methods.name: AddDiagnosticInformation
methods.description: Adds exception type, message, and stack trace details to the JSON response when in debug mode.
